AGENDA ITEM TITLE
Resolution approving submission of an Iowa DOT Traffic Safety grant application, in the amount of
$120,000.00, for the Intersection of Mobile Street and Sumner Street Obsolete Signal Replacement
Project, and committing to implementing and maintaining the signals for the life of the project.
RECOMMENDED COUNCIL ACTION
Approve Resolution
SUMMARY STATEMENT AND BACKGROUND INFORMATION
School signals at Sumner Street intersection with Mobile Street intersection are not standard as there
is a mix of stop signs and traffic signals. This application is for replacing the signals with compliant
modern traffic signals.
